summary: The skill is a documentation-only financial knowledge base manager. It describes document organization, RAG semantic search with illustrative pseudocode, and a Dianjin-style customer profiling and investment advice workflow. It declares no env vars and asks for no keys, wallets, hosts or binaries. It has no download, execution, encoded-payload or outbound network behavior in the files. The only external links are provenance references (clawhub.ai, github.com) in skill-card.md.

findings.message: The RAG search code is illustrative pseudocode: embed_text, vector_search, rerank and generate_answer are undefined, and no backend, host or credential is specified.
The skill goes beyond internal knowledge retrieval into customer profiling and personalized investment recommendations, which needs compliance review before use.
The skill instructs retaining customer risk-assessment records for at least 5 years, a customer-data retention practice that should be reviewed.
The SKILL.md frontmatter declares version 5.0.0 while the release is 5.0.6, and the frontmatter has no metadata.openclaw block or requires.env.
The skill card says the security review is incomplete (only half of the components were inspected), and the registry header shows a SUSPICIOUS verdict with warnings.
